name: mcpu26
description: mcpu26 (legacy form): mcpu08's energy function, with tables re-estimated from PISCES 2026 and weights fitted on Tsuboyama natural domains, folded into the tables. Its weights were fitted with clash_alpha 0.85 and clash_bond_exclusion 3.

provenance.source: the parameter folder mcpu26_v1b_w5 of 2026-10-19: the v1b tables (legacy estimators on the cleaned PISCES 2026 pool) times the weights of the W1-W5 fit, with the tables moved from mcpu_params/ to mcpu26_params/. hbond_seq_dep.bin and the constants are v1b's; the constants are byte copies of mcpu08's.
provenance.weights_rule: each weight multiplies its v1b table at mcpu08's group weights (folded_weights); hbfar enters as hbond_beta_favor = float32(3 x hbfar / hb4)

fitted_with.clash_start_exemption: true in runs, false in start-structure relaxations
